name: ATK_TECHNOLOGY_ASSETS
description: ATK_TECHNOLOGY_ASSETS contains Fusion Service, SDO and Service operation asset details.

columns.name: TECHNOLOGY_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier of the technology assets.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: QNAME
columns.description: Identifies an asset uniquely using the namespace and local name.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the name of an asset.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Identifies the description of an asset.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: Identifies the STATE of an asset. The state can be STANDARD, NEW or CUSTOMIZED.

columns.name: LBO
columns.description: Identifies the logical business object for a service asset.

columns.name: LAST_HARVEST_DATE
columns.description: The date when the asset was last harvested.

columns.name: LIFE_CYCLE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the life cycle code of an asset.

columns.name: LAST_HARVEST_STATUS
columns.description: Identifies the status of the last harvest process such as COMPLETE, IN_PROGRESS or FAILED.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
